chinese: 答案来自原文不推理不脑补
english: The answer comes from the original text without inference or guessing
soundmark: /ðə ˈɑːnsər kʌmz frɒm ðə əˈrɪdʒɪnəl tekst wɪˈðaʊt ˈɪnfərəns ɔːr ˈɡesɪŋ/

chinese: 正确选项是原文的同义改写
english: The correct option is a paraphrase of the original text
soundmark: /ðə kəˈrekt ˈɒpʃən ɪz ə ˈpærəfreɪz ɒv ðə əˈrɪdʒɪnəl tekst/

chinese: 错误选项有明显特征可以一眼排除
english: Wrong options have obvious features and can be eliminated at a glance
soundmark: /rɒŋ ˈɒpʃənz hæv ˈɒbviəs ˈfiːtʃərz ænd kæn biː ɪˈlɪmɪneɪtɪd æt ə ɡlɑːns/

chinese: 优先找不会被改写的词如大写人名地名数字
english: Prioritize words that will not be paraphrased such as capitalized names places and numbers
soundmark: /praɪˈɒrɪtaɪz wɜːrdz ðæt wɪl nɒt biː ˈpærəfreɪzd sʌtʃ æz ˈkæpɪtəlaɪzd neɪmz ˈpleɪsɪz ænd ˈnʌmbərz/

chinese: 答案百分之九十在定位句本句或下一句
english: Ninety percent of answers are in the located sentence or the next one
soundmark: /ˈnaɪnti pərˈsent ɒv ˈɑːnsərz ɑːr ɪn ðə loʊˈkeɪtɪd ˈsentəns ɔːr ðə nekst wʌn/

chinese: 从选项里最独特的词反推定位原文
english: Use the most distinctive word in the options to locate the original text in reverse
soundmark: /juːz ðə moʊst dɪˈstɪŋktɪv wɜːrd ɪn ðə ˈɒpʃənz tuː loʊˈkeɪt ðə əˈrɪdʒɪnəl tekst ɪn rɪˈvɜːrs/

chinese: 动词和形容词最容易被替换要慎用作定位词
english: Verbs and adjectives are most easily replaced so use them cautiously as locating words
soundmark: /vɜːrbz ænd ˈædʒɪktɪvz ɑːr moʊst ˈiːzɪli rɪˈpleɪst soʊ juːz ðəm ˈkɔːʃəsli æz loʊˈkeɪtɪŋ wɜːrdz/
